results.title: ABrush: AI Studio for Digital Artists | Product Hunt
results.content:
What makes ABrush different  
  
ABrush brings 23+ leading AI models directly into Photoshop, so artists can access AI without constantly exporting, switching, downloading, and importing. But being inside Photoshop is only part of it.  
  
It is a creative suite that turns often unpredictable AI generation into a much more controlled and repeatable process. Your style, process, and action sequences can be encoded into reusable workflows.  
  
And this extends across teams. Styles, settings, workflows, and generation libraries can be shared, so a studio can build up its own creative system rather than having every artist start from scratch. [...] ABrush

ABrush [...] Throughout all of this, the artist stays in control. We want AI to speed up the difficult and repetitive parts of production, while giving artists more ways to direct the result, not decide what the artwork should look like for them.
